items.quote: So, in terms of the share of the domestic ticketin g in the Air GTV, it contributes around one-third in terms of GTV per se. So, yes, we have seen marginal decline in GTV in terms of the air numbers YoY and primarily , we are working on the same. So, this quarter we are looking at least we should be end up flat or some single digit growth in GTV numbers in here for the coming quarter.

items.statement: Jumbonline revenue seasonality: heavy Q4 (Jan-Mar bookings), lighter Q2 (check-in period).
items.quote: Jumbonline largely depends on European leisure traffic coming to the Mediterranean beach destinations. Europe books much in advance. So, you will start to see summer bookings happen, already start ing to happen in November, December and you will see heavy booking windows in January to March quarter as well. Because the way our revenue recognition works is on booking and not on actual date of check

items.statement: Hotel take rate expected to remain in 7.2%-7.6% range.
items.quote: Yes, it should remain in the range , you may see cyclic movements, but it should remain in the range of between 7.2 and 7.6.

items.statement: Employee base ~2,100 including contractors; ~200 added in current year; growth focused on international sales, ops, tech.
items.quote: The employee base is roughly about 2,100 odd including contractors. I don't have a split handy with me . So, about 200 employees have been added or employees/contractors have been added in the current year.

items.statement: Actively evaluating acquisition pipeline; value-conscious; no immediate deals to announce.
items.quote: I think we are constantly evaluating opportunities, acquisitions inorganic growth with a stated objective but like we have said in the past we are very value conscious of new opportunities and how we evaluate them. So, there is nothing to share at this point in time in the short term immediately. But rest assured, ther e is a pipeline that we are evaluating as we speak.

items.statement: India active buyer growth muted due to high base; focusing on tier 4/5 city penetration.
items.quote: Basically, India, if you see as a high, very high base of transacting buyers. So, in this quarter, the growth was muted. However, we are focusing in current year to penetrate more into the tier 4 and tier 5 cities to increase our buyer base in India.

items.statement: Hotel buyer base in India grew ~4% YoY; top 1,000 agents show zero churn.
items.quote: But Karan, on the hotel side, our buyer base increased by almost 4% because what you're seeing is obviously one number. Yes, we kind of lost about 300, 400 long tail agents because of reasons mostly in the domestic airlines. But overall, our top 1,000 agents, there's no churn there at all, which are obviously the significant contributor in our business.

items.statement: Management happy to maintain ~20% EBITDA margin while investing in growth; no immediate plan to expand margin.
items.quote: So, while you would see that the EBITDA margin is still pretty strong about 20% EBITDA margin, we would be quite happy if we can maintain the 20% EBITDA margin while continuing to invest into the growth initiatives we are taking. So, no immediate plan to focus on expanding EBITDA margin now, given the runway for growth is so long.

items.statement: Organic GTV growth ~14% YoY in Q2 FY25.
items.quote: Vikas Jain: Yes, around 14%.

items.statement: Q3 historically weakest quarter; expect similar trend but international momentum to continue YoY.
items.quote: See Swapnil, during the last call we discussed that Q2 is typically heavier than Q1 and that kind of played out for us because of seasonality. Similar to that Q3 in our business is usually the weakest quarter because it's end of summer, so if you look at October-November-December except for the Christmas and New Year, largely no major triggers for leisure bookings. So, you would expect historicall

items.statement: Direct hotel sourcing ~33-35% of hotel business; no material change expected short term.
items.quote: Vidhi, the number is pretty much at the same level right now, about a third, about 33%-35% of our businesses coming from direct sourcing. And we do not expect to change it very materially either way in the short to medium term.

items.statement: International active agent growth >20% YoY; enterprise level ~6-7% YoY consistent.
items.quote: Vidhi, I think at an enterprise level, year-on-year growth was similar last year, last quarter as well, about 6% or 7%. The growth you're looking at is the growth in TBO Tek Limited Nov 12th, 2024 the international source markets, where yes it was close to 20 % and in fact it's higher than 20% in this quarter

items.statement: Geopolitical/macro headwinds in some source markets; business from small base in large TAM provides buffer.
items.quote: Having said that, look, I think it will be foolish to say that we will be completely immune to any major geopolitical or macroeconomic headwinds that may happen. Our only comment remains that we are coming from a small base in a very large TAM. So, hopefully, in the short to medium term, we should be able to find ways to grow in spite of some of these headwinds.

items.statement: Targeting INR8,000 crores revenue for March 2025 and INR9,500 crores for March 2026
items.quote: with respect to the top line we are targeting around INR8,000 crores for March 25 and around INR9,500 crores for March 26

items.statement: Capex per new company-owned store is INR1.5-1.75 crores; inventory infusion INR30-32 crores per store
items.quote: So, start with this FOCO store because typically we are planning to infuse around INR30 crores to INR32 crores of the inventory and 1.5 to 1.75 is the investment that we are doing in terms of capex.

items.statement: Opened 9 stores in October post-IPO; plan 5-6 more in Q3/Q4 FY25 and 10 in FY26, all company-owned in Maharashtra
items.quote: We will be adding another 5 to 6 stores in Q3 and Q4. So, that way that will take the tariff to close to 55. And then in the financial FY25-26, we will be further adding another 10 more stores in Maharashtra.

items.statement: Targeting 10-12% gross margin in next 2-3 quarters via higher studded mix, lower finance cost, IIBX sourcing, and lower making charges
items.quote: So, typically, we are planning to reach 10% to 12% gross margin in the next 2 to 3 quarters.

items.statement: Custom duty cut caused INR18.55 crores profit reduction in Q2; net impact INR3.31 crores after replenishment
items.quote: The custom duty impact, which has been, you know, on the 22nd of July, the Government of India has decided to cut down the duty and basis of that and the impact of the reduction in the custom duty is INR18.5 crores reduction in the profit.

items.statement: Festive demand strong: volumes up 7-8% and value up 35-40% YoY on like-for-like stores; gold volumes up 19%, diamond carats up 11% in Q2
items.quote: In terms of volumes, we would have grown around 7% to 8% over last Diwali, but in value we are up around 35% to 40%.

items.statement: Hedging currently 50-55% (20-25% GML, 30% replenishment); target 70% by March 2025 and 75-80% eventually; unhedged inventory carries mark-to-market risk
items.quote: So, currently, we are doing hedging through GML is around 20% and through replenishment model around 30%. So, that is around 50% to 55% we are currently doing. Our target is to reach around 70% by March 25.

items.statement: IPO proceeds used to open 9 stores (commitment for Mar-25 met early) and repay term loans/working capital; bank restructuring and security release in pipeline, expected by Q3
items.quote: At the same time, we have discussed also that we will restructure the bank borrowing so that there will be reduction in the finance cost. So, we have successfully completed our IPO on 17th of September, and that is hardly just 2 weeks closer to the Q2. But having said that, we have utilized the funds to swap the existing bank facility.

items.statement: Revenue per sq ft >INR6 lakh; revenue per store >INR95 crores for H1; stock turns >5x; conversion >93%; ROCE/ROE attractive; 3-4 year CAGR >40%
items.quote: Our revenue per square feet is upward of INR6 lakh per square feet. Our revenue per store is upward of INR95 crores for the half year ended September. Our ROCE, ROE both are attractive. Our growth for the last 3-4 years combined CAGR has been upward of 40%.

items.statement: FY25 revenue guidance maintained at INR 1,000 crore; downside range INR 870-1,000 crore
items.quote: The range that we're looking at and I'll be very upfront with you is on the downside we're looking at anywhere around INR870 crores which is about INR100 crores more than last year. And on the upside, I'm still sticking to around INR1,000.

items.statement: Full-year EBITDA margin expected between 17% and 18%
items.quote: Between 17% and 18% is what you can expect for the full year.

items.statement: Fintech vertical declined due to largest customer reorg deferring spend; expected recovery in H2
items.quote: Fintech has gone down because there has been a little bit of some challenges for us in our biggest account there. There's been some changes in the organization of our customer, some reorg, which has deferred spending, but that's going to pick up in the second half of this year.

items.statement: Hi-Tech Media & Utilities vertical expected to drive maximum growth in coming quarters
items.quote: Our biggest vertical today is Hi-Tech Media & Utilities. And that is where you will see the maximum growth in the coming quarters. We are very bullish about Hi-Tech.

items.statement: Transport & Logistics vertical facing consolidation and bankruptcies in US; no great growth expected near term
items.quote: Logistics has had a rough year because there has been a consolidation in that space in the US market. There's been a lot of bankruptcies in that space. There is a shakeout. It contributes about 16% of our revenues. I don't see great growth in that

items.statement: Q2 EBITDA margin 17.08% impacted by July salary increments; expected to correct over next 6 months
items.quote: The only reason for muted EBITDA has been the increments. We gave the appraisals and the increments to our workforce, to our employees effective 1st July. So that has had an impact this quarter. It will get corrected.

items.statement: Ceptes acquisition at 15% EBITDA margin; target to improve to 20%+ via cross-sell to existing customers
items.quote: In terms of margin, it's about 15% EBITDA margin. We are confident of taking that up to 20%-plus because we'll be able to take those services to a lot of our existing customers.

items.statement: Augmento contributing INR 4 crore/month (INR 12 crore/quarter); expected stable for next 6-8 months
items.quote: Augmento is contributing about INR4 crores a month to our revenue and that is something that we can take at least for the next 6 to 8 months.

items.statement: Acquired Ceptes Software for ~INR 62 crore including earn-out; revenue base ~INR 20 crore, PAT margin ~12%
items.quote: The overall consideration, including the earn-out will be in the range of INR62 crores, about.

items.statement: Actively seeking acquisitions: strong Microsoft Azure partner or ServiceNow partner for FY26/FY27
items.quote: We're looking for an acquisition, a strong Azure -- Microsoft Azure partner or a strong ServiceNow partner.

items.statement: Net cash surplus of INR178 crores after adjusting borrowings
items.quote: Seamec remains in a strong financial position with a net cash surplus of INR178 crores after adjusting the borrowing.

items.statement: Consolidated ROCE 14% and ROE 16% in H1 FY25
items.quote: The ROCE has improved to 14% and ROE to 16% on a consolidated basis.

items.statement: Robust demand for subsea inspection, maintenance and construction services; fleet in high demand
items.quote: The demand for subsea inspection, maintenance and construction services remains robust and we are well positioned to continue executing on our strategic priorities. Our fleet remains in high demand and we expect continued positive contributions from projects and ongoing work for ONGC.

items.statement: Ongoing partnership with ONGC, Aramco and AdNoc for incremental E&P activities
items.quote: With our advanced fleet and skilled teams, we are well-positioned to support the incremental exploration and production activities for key clients, including ONGC, Aramco and AdNoc.

items.statement: UK subsidiary liquidation process ongoing; will update exchanges when decided
items.quote: Yes. So, that is an ongoing process. So, that is going on. So, on that also, we will be coming back to the exchanges as and when this is decided.

items.statement: CEO Rakesh Ayri joined management team on call
items.quote: Today, joining me, Mr. Rakesh Ayri, our CEO, Mr. Vinay Agarwal, CFO, and Mr. Sunil Gupta, Vice President, Strategy and Investor Relations.

items.statement: East Coast opportunities developing as fields develop; will pursue when mature
items.quote: East Coast, as we have conveyed even in that earlier call also that there are opportunities which are coming up sinc e the field is developing. So, definitely there will be opportunities coming up. So, soon we will be looking at something that is coming up in the East Coast as well

items.statement: OSV vessel repaired after technical issue; will be rehired soon per exchange filing
items.quote: So, now that vessel is now ready, there was some unfortunate incident that vessel has to be taken out and it has to be repaired. But now that vessel is ready, so maybe you will be soon seeing this exchange filing that vessel has been rehired again or put into the contract again very soon.

items.statement: Contract durations vary from spot (1-2 years) to 3-5 years; no fixed pattern
items.quote: the average tenure of the contract is normally around three to five years. But again, if you have seen our stock exchange filing, you will see there is a mix of information out there. Some contracts are on spot contracts, so maybe for one year or two year basis. Some are three year and some are even five year contract also. So ther e is no fixed pattern in the contract duration

items.statement: Repricing only at contract expiry via new tenders; no mid-contract rate adjustments
items.quote: No, there is no possibility to increase the rate during the currency of the contract or middle of the contract. The repricing happens only once the contracts are over and then typically all these contracts are rolling kind of thing. So, new tender comes and during that period of time that repricing takes place.

items.statement: Payback period target 5-7 years for vessel acquisitions; reject if beyond 7 years
items.quote: As a thumb rule, we try to get this payback between five to seven years. And if it is going beyond seven years, then we do not take the decision of buying the asset.

items.statement: Confirmed FY25 revenue guidance of over INR500 crores
items.quote: I'm happy to confirm that we will achieve the earnings guidance given at the beginning of the year of over INR500 crores of sales in FY25.

items.statement: H1 FY25 tire processing volume up 25% YoY; Q2 up 19% YoY but down QoQ due to monsoon
items.quote: On a half yearly basis, the volume of tires processed in H1 FY25 has increased by 25% year-on-year basis. And on a quarterly basis, the volume has increased by 19% year-on-year.

items.statement: Varle plant contributed INR16 crores in H1, expected INR75-100 crores for FY25
items.quote: In H1 FY25, our Varle plant has contributed about INR16 crores in revenue, and it is expected to contribute about INR75 c rores to INR100 crores in this financial year

items.statement: H1 EBITDA margin 17.29% (+186 bps YoY); Q2 EBITDA margin 16.3%; TP Buildtech at ~22% EBITDA margin
items.quote: EBITDA grew to INR44 crores, up 77% and EBITDA margin increased by 186 bps to 17.29% compared to 15.43% in H1 FY24.

items.statement: INR48 crore FY25 capex plan; INR33 crores spent, INR4-5 crores more committed; Saudi plant INR125 crores phased
items.quote: Out of INR48 crores of capex plan, which we have shared with you earlier in the year, we have already spent INR33 crores, and the work is progressing as per plan.

items.statement: Gummidipoondi MRP capacity doubled to 10,000 TPA (total 20,000 TPA); Oman at 85-90% utilization; Saudi 20-25k TPA by H1 FY26; South Africa JV by Q1 FY26
items.quote: At the Gummidipoondi plant in Chennai, Tinna Rubber has doubled its MR P capacity from 5,000 tons per annum to 10,000 tons per annum, and this makes us possibly the largest MRP producer in the world, with a capacity of 20,000 tons per annum

items.statement: Raw material costs up; Red Sea disruption increased logistics; solar plants at Wada/Varle to save power cost from Q3
items.quote: Cost of raw materials increased due to increase in raw material prices, impact of Red Sea disruption reflected in increased logistic costs and an increase in outward logistic costs.

items.statement: MRP ~10-15% of H1 sales; CRMB 30 mesh; reclaimed rubber competitive vs China; MRP higher margin than crumb
items.quote: Also to -- just to give you a specific answer to your question, approximately 10% to 15% of our total sale in H1 is of MRP.

items.statement: All major Indian tire OEMs buy both MRP and reclaim; tire cos resistant to price hikes citing EPR benefits
items.quote: But what I can tell you is from our data, all tire companies buy both from us.

items.statement: India+China make >90% of world reclaim; India very competitive in MRP manufacturing globally
items.quote: And even in reclaimed, I think between India and China probably makes over 90% of the reclaimed grade in the world.

items.statement: MoEF set EPR floor price INR2,520/unit, env compensation INR8,500/unit; Q2 EPR accrual INR11 crores (INR8.5 cr PBT impact)
items.quote: On EPR front, MoEF, Ministry of Environment and Forest has finalized the environmental compensation at the rate of INR8,500 per unit and has set a floor price of INR2,520 per unit.

items.statement: Industrial exports volume up 75% YoY in H1; ECHA registered for EU REACH exports; Oman revenue ~USD2M in H1
items.quote: In the Industrial segment, we have witnessed a remarkable growth of 36%, exports have grown by 75% in volume in H1 FY25 and will continue to be a strong focus area for us.

items.statement: Trade receivables INR38 crores (Sept '24) vs INR31 crores (Mar '24); debtor days <40-45; sales run-rate doubled
items.quote: This September, our debtor stands at INR38 crores. The sales had increased, so the debtor has increased. However, our number of days are less than 40, 45 receivables.

items.statement: CARE upgraded rating to BBB- (investment grade) from BB+
items.quote: I'm very happy to share that CARE ratings have upgraded our credit rating to investment grade BBB- from a BB+.

items.statement: Planning INR150 crore fundraise primarily for capex and acquisitions, not working capital; may repay debt if deployment delayed
items.quote: So we expect the fundraise amount to be largely used for capex and acquisitions essentially, not really for working capital.

items.statement: South Africa JV signed for tire recycling plant (semi-processing initially); Saudi 100% subsidiary registered
items.quote: In South Africa, I'm happy to share we have signed a joint venture to set up a tire recycling plant, we intend to initially undertake only semi processing of end-of-life tires since it's a complex geography.

items.statement: India recycled rubber penetration ~2-2.5% of tire production; tire cos target 10% by 2030
items.quote: of now around 2% to 2.5% of the total tire production i n the recycled rubber material, but each and each and every tire company is now -- have carbon neutralization mission. So wherein by 2030, they want to achieve a level of 10% of the recycled rubber material addition to their systems

items.statement: EPR credit monetization delayed due to tire industry raw material cost pressure; Q3-Q4 expected recovery
items.quote: I think this whole traction will start from Q3, Q4 onwards.

items.statement: SA 8000 Certification qualified; testament to worker practices
items.quote: Tinna has qualified and registered with ECHA for export of REACH-compliant products to European Union and have qualified for SA 8000 Certification.

items.statement: Vision 2027: 10 plants (from 6), 25%+ revenue CAGR, 18% EBITDA margin, 33% profit growth, 30% ROCE, 250k+ MT crushing capacity
items.quote: Tinna Rubber is making significant progress towards its vision 2027, which includes expanding recycling plants from the current 6 to 10 locations, achieving a revenue CAGR of 25% plus, EBITDA margin of 18%, profitability growth of 33% and a ROCE of 30%.

items.statement: Management confident of achieving 15-20% revenue growth for FY25 despite Q2 headwinds
items.quote: 15 to 20% growth in our conservative target for time to come, however, in Q2, the geopolitical situation, we disrupted the exports and slowing the boosting demand.

items.statement: Target revenue of nearly Rs 4,000 crore for FY25 vs Rs 3,500 crore last year
items.quote: Its view that we should almost reach 4000 cores this financial year, last year it was 3500 and this year we should reach almost 4000 nearby 4000.

items.quote: we commissioned the plant large diameter heavy wall, thicker pipe for making hydraulic tube in month of September which is one of the very few plants in the world and this commercial production will start anytime in the last quarter of this year anytime. The facility has been installed with the investment of 200 crore in the capacity of 15,000 metric ton.

items.statement: Defense and aerospace subsidiary plant likely commissioned by March 2025, commercial production from April 2025
items.quote: Our subsidiary Goodluck defense and aerospace progress is going at a very fast pace and we are likely to commission that plant by end of this financial year

items.quote: we have got an order of 22,000 metric tons and out of that we have produced almost 65% order and in next 8 to 9 months, maximum to 12 months, it will be completed.

items.quote: Solar support structure. We are already supplying for 200 MW already. We are supplying for solar support structure and it is doing well, we have the good order books there and we almost everybody we are supplying

items.quote: It will be maintained it has to improve year after year. There is no reason. I don't see any reason for it to go down.

items.quote: When this defense CapEx is completed and this LDP plant is ramped up so, there will be a real significant improvement in the EBITDA margins and which are most likely to you can see in the in the next financial year.

items.quote: Our exports are nearly thousand crores annually. However, in the first half, second quarter of this year, export took a hit or due to geopolitical tensions on the sea routes, red sea problem. However, our emphasis is once again on export only.

items.statement: Steel prices very volatile during quarter, going down every month, creating difficult situation for processing industry
items.quote: steel price going down every month, you can imagine what kind of situation which we have, but I feel the company has done very well.

items.statement: Focus on value-added products: hydraulic tubes, defense, solar structures; CR coil business low margin, no expansion or demerger planned
items.quote: The company's focus on increasing its range of value-added products reflected deep understanding of evolving customer needs and a dedication to deliver superior and tailored solutions.

items.quote: Actually our other income is the interest income and export rebates and some other income also, so further details you can e-mail us, we will clarify and many other miscellaneous incomes.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions, US elections, rupee volatility, steel price unpredictability disrupting exports and demand

items.quote: heavy monsoon all over the country. Elections, Indian elections, US election, we are export thrust company, disruption in export definitely affected the demand but still we were able to record a moderate growth of 10%.

items.quote: In Q2, we received the letter of award for the Jigaon Water Lifting project valued at INR317.6 crores for which we earlier declared lowest bidder. Our share in this project is around INR111 crores.

items.quote: Over and above, we have signed MOUs with two major PSUs, RVNL and Ircon International Limited. These partnerships will strengthen our ability to deliver infrastructure projects both domestically and internationally, improving project execution through shared expertise.

items.quote: Right now, we can only say that from 1 year from now, we are looking at around INR10,000 crores, INR12,000 crores order inflow.

items.quote: And the margins are similar to what we get in hydro. So we expect on an average same 14%, 15% margins to be maintained.

items.quote: See, segment-wise EBITDA, what we see is our average margin is around 14%, where hydro gives us around 100, 200 basis points higher. And the other segments are around 200 basis points lower and hydro being more than 50%, so average comes at 14%.

items.statement: Target to pay off term debt of INR650 crores over next 3-4 years
items.quote: So, see, we have a term debt of around INR650 crores right now. We expect to pay the term debt over the next few years. say, around 3 years -- 3, 4 years from now. So that is our target that we'll pay off the term debt.

items.statement: Net working capital days at 112 days after adjusting for land, arbitration awards, borrowings and cash
items.quote: In terms of working capital, the net working capital days after adjusting for land arbitration awards and borrowings and cash and bank balances around 112 days.

items.quote: But what we see is that around 30 gigawatt of projects should come up for bidding in the next 1, 1.5 years.

items.quote: Yes, we are planning. See, our major focus will remain hydro, but along with hydro, we'll be focusing on irrigation, water sector, pipeline work and road sector. Other sector also, we are targeting.

As regards irrigation, which is most of the state work, so we are focusing on Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra.

items.statement: Credit rating improved to A minus; expect interest cost reduction of 50-100 bps as rates start coming down

items.statement: Hydro project revenue peaks in years 3-4 of 5-year cycle; first 6-9 months mobilization, year 5 finishing work
items.quote: No, normally cycle, see how it happens when a hydro project first 6 to 9 months goes for mobilization, revenue starts coming from the second year, third year, third and fourth is the peak year. items.quote: The order book position is INR 720.5 crore including INR 672 crores of product business and INR 48.4 crore of project and services business. items.statement: Margins dropped ~10% due to conscious investment in people and technology; target is to return to last year's margin levels through cost optimization and IP sales

items.statement: Management strives to return to ~25% EBIT margin achieved last year via new sales and Hoshin Kanri cost optimization

items.statement: Elongated decision-making across industry due to regulatory changes and cautious customer evaluations
items.quote: The sales cycle today has been a little longer in the entire industry itself and this is the trend we and our peers' companies are also experiencing.

items.statement: Gross fixed asset additions of INR 2.55 crore in Q2 FY25, primarily computers, servers, office equipment and software

items.statement: AMC repricing smoothly accepted by existing customers; not a cause for elongated sales cycles

items.quote: Recently, we got around INR440 crores worth from Indo-Bangla border fencing. So future also, there will be a scope for us.

items.quote: The transaction is expected to be cash flow-accretive, improving our working capital cycle, providing increased liquidity which will help positively impact the ROCE.

items.statement: Gross debt Rs 28 crores, liquidity Rs 205 crores; debt-to-equity 0.07 (down from 0.14), net debt-to-equity -0.42 (from -0.17); expect further decline in leverage

items.statement: Flex workspace market projected to treble from Rs 108B to Rs 380B by FY28 (25-27% CAGR); flex absorption 25% of total CRE in FY24; penetration to reach 20% by FY28 from 10% currently

items.statement: Primary risk in managed aggregation model is occupancy buildup risk - speculative centers need to achieve occupancy in right timeframe to deliver contribution margins for both Awfis and space owner
items.quote: The primary risk we run in this managed aggregation model is that these are speculative centers. When I say speculative, that means that we need to build the occupancy of these centers post committing to sign up these centers.

items.statement: ESOP cost from 2015 policy vesting completes in next 2 quarters and Q1 FY26; new policy will have similar cost trend; no incremental impact beyond what's baked in
items.quote: Most of the vesting for the existing policy which is 2015 ESOP policy will get completed in the next two quarters and probably in the first quarter of the next year.

items.statement: Divested Awfis Care facility management business to SMS Integrated Facility Services for Rs 27.5 crores in Sep 2024; enhances focus on core flex workspace, improves cash flow and ROCE
items.quote: In September 2024, we successfully divested Awfis Care, our facility management business, to SMS Integrated Facility Services, a company known for its technology -driven capability.

items.statement: No plans to launch SM REIT for fundraising as of now
items.quote: So, as of now there is no plan.

items.statement: Seasonality minimal on demand side; minor deferral of seat signings during festivals/year-end; utility costs higher in summer months
items.quote: On the cost side, there is a bit of impact on utilities. So, across various regions during the summer months, there is a bit larger impact and utility bills are a bit on a higher side.

items.statement: New Anjar Facility II to be commissioned in Q3 FY25, boosting capacity from 6,000 to 15,000 metric tons, total capacity to 112,500 metric tons
items.quote: We are establishing the new Anjar Facility II, which will be commissioned in Q3 of FY '25, and this will boost our capacity from 6,000 metric tons to 15,000 metric tons, bringing the total capacity to 1,12,500 metric tons.

items.statement: Board approved seamless pipe plant with 7,000 tons annual capacity, 900 million capex, 225 million internal, operational by Q4 FY26
items.quote: We have obtained approval from our Board of Directors to establish a plant for manufacturing fold seamless pipes with an annual capacity of 7,000 tons, involving a capital outlay of 900 million, out of which 225 million will be from the internal approvals.

items.statement: Seamless pipe plant expected to yield 4,500 million annual revenue at peak with 30-35% IRR
items.quote: At the optimum level, this plant will yield an annual revenue of 4,500 million at its peak, while the internal rate of return for the investment is expected to be around 30% to 35%.

items.statement: Order book at 11,921 million as of 30 September 2024, up from 8,001 million as of 30 June 2024
items.quote: As of 30th September 2024, our order book stood at 11,921 million, up from 8,001 million as of 30th June 2024.

items.statement: Q2 FY25 operating EBITDA margin expanded 196 bps QoQ and 195 bps YoY to 15.4%
items.quote: Operating EBITDA in Q2 FY '25 saw quarter -on-quarter increase of 20.2% and year on year increase of 24.5%, reaching 298 million with an operating EBITDA margin expans ion of 196 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 195 basis points year-on-year to 15.4%.

items.statement: Q2 FY25 PAT margin expanded 891 bps QoQ and 529 bps YoY to 10.6%
items.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at 223 million, up by 598.8% quarter-on-quarter and 125.2% year-on-year with PAT margin expanding by 891 basis points quarter on quarter and 529 basis points year-on-year to 10.6%.

items.statement: New Anjar facility expected to bring 1-2% logistics cost savings and operational efficiency boosting EBITDA margins
items.quote: So, it will bring at least 1 % to 2% of logistics cost savings in overall revenue scheme. So, that will give us a good amount of boost, not only in terms of enhancing our EBITDA margins, but also this plant will bring a lot of operational efficiency.

items.statement: Seamless pipe plant expected to have around 20% EBITDA margin
items.quote: So, the EBITDA margin would be around 20% in this product line.

items.statement: Oil and gas order pipeline expected to remain extremely strong for next 3-4 years with 50% domestic, 50% export mix
items.quote: And, we expect at least coming three to four years an extremely good order book from oil and gas itself.

items.statement: Seamless pipe plant is 100% import substitute for P91/P92 grade pipes used in 660+ MW thermal plants and subsea projects
items.quote: So, it's basically 100% import substitute only because at present nobody in India is manufacturing these pipes. As a matter of fact, in India, even now normal seamless pipes are not manufactured in P91 and P92 grades for which we are establishing this plant.

items.statement: Medium-term guidance delayed due to new seamless pipe project; will provide on or before next earnings call
items.quote: However, since we have very recently initiated the seamless pipe projects, we have not been able to finalize the revised business plan incorporating the new project and we will surely get back to you with the detailed medium -term guidance on/ or before the next earnings call.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of 3,250 million, 2,769.25 crores utilized so far for working capital and debt repayment
items.quote: Of the total gross IPO proceeds of 3 ,250 million, we have utilized INR2,769.25 crores so far.

items.statement: Gross margin range historically 30-40%, sometimes above 40%, depends on job mix
items.quote: So, I would always say that the gross margin range would be ranging from 30 % to 40% and sometimes it is more than 40% and sometimes, many times it remains between 35 % to 40%.

items.statement: Steel price volatility does not impact margins due to back-to-back procurement contracts
items.quote: Therefore, I would say we have seen four to five cycles where there was a lot of volatility in the steel prices, but we have never got any impact in terms of the profitability of those volatility in the past.

items.statement: Management reaffirms target of INR 900-1,000 crores revenue in next 3 to 3.5 years
items.quote: So there is no correction as far as our forecast of reaching a INR 1,000 crores in the next 3 years to 3.5 years is very much there in place.

items.statement: Targeting PAT margin of more than 12% by end of 3 to 4 years
items.quote: we believe that our margins and profitability we are targeting to arrive at anything more than 12% of PAT by the end of 3 years to 4 years t hat is the vision

items.statement: Plan to roll out 11 stores in FY25 and reach 100 stores in next 3 years from current 64
items.quote: So, basically, in terms of our store rollout plan, there will be no stopping us and we will continue to roll out these 11 stores for this year.

items.statement: Order book at start of H2 FY25 better than previous year; B2B forecasts for Q3/Q4 awaited from Toyota and IKEA
items.quote: With a better-than-previous-year order book at the start of H2 FY25, we remain positive to have better business in the remaining quarters of this year.

items.statement: Gross margin run-rate at 56% from Q4 FY24; Q1 FY25 dip was one-off; localization and efficiency driving structural improvement
items.quote: We are at about 56% of gross margin run rate from quarter 4 onwards last year. And quarter 1 was an exception where it dipped because it was a one-off transaction.

items.statement: Pricing headroom exists vs European brands due to their rising costs; price increases expected in Level Next format
items.quote: So we do always continue to have a headroom to increase our pricing because the acceptance level in India also is constantly increasing.

items.statement: B2C retail grew 5% YoY in Q2; H2 typically contributes 55-56% of annual revenue; new store maturation and property handovers expected to drive growth
items.quote: We remain very positive in terms of B2C sales and we think we will definitely continue growing there.

items.statement: Transitioning from sofa-centric to complete home solutions; casegoods fastest growing; target sofa share to drop from 55% to 40-45%
items.quote: From 2025 onwards, Stanley is going to be positioned more as a luxury full home custom furniture manufacturing company and moving away from the typical Sofa only kind of company.

items.statement: B2B segment weak; awaiting H2 forecasts from key accounts Toyota and IKEA; B2B2C cash-and-carry transition caused 60% decline but normalizing
items.quote: B2B is still looking a bit weak. We have not yet got our what they call as forecast for Q3 as well as Q4. So we are hoping that will pick up.

items.statement: Net cash balance of INR 2,112 million as of Sep 30, 2024 supports growth plans
items.quote: As of September 30, 2024, Stanley Lifestyles holds a strong financial position with net cash balance of INR 2,112 million.

items.statement: Unicommerce to acquire ~43% stake in Shipway for INR 684M cash; remaining stake via non-cash merger or stock swap within 12 months

items.statement: Second tranche valuation expected to be in similar range but slightly higher than first tranche

items.statement: Shipway annualized revenue run rate INR 550-600M as of September 2024
items.quote: The business currently has an annualized revenue run rate of INR 550 to 600 million as of September 2024.

items.statement: Shipway gross margin ~20%; courier aggregation contributes ~85% of revenue
items.quote: Gross margin for the company stands at approximately 20%, with courier aggregation contributing around 85% of the total revenue in FY24.

items.quote: The loss in the company is steadily reducing over the years and our objective post transaction is to reach a breakeven point quickly, primarily through accelerated sales growth and realizing synergies across both direct and indirect costs.

items.quote: In quarter 2 FY25, we reported near about 21% of adjusted EBITDA margin, which is 322 basis points increase year-on-year from quarter 2 FY24.

items.statement: Unicommerce expects core business adjusted EBITDA margins to grow in FY25 vs FY24 due to operating leverage

items.statement: Objective post-acquisition to reach breakeven quickly via accelerated sales growth and cost synergies; full-year guidance to be given in Q3 earnings call
items.quote: Our objective post transaction is to reach a breakeven point quickly, primarily through accelerated sales growth and realizing synergies across both direct and indirect costs.

items.quote: Although the percentage-wise gross margin for this product is lower than that of Unicommerce's core business, the much higher revenue per transaction significantly enhances the gross margin potential in absolute terms and makes this business an attractive proposition for us.

items.quote: See, the shipping automation is similar to the TAM that we had mentioned for the order fulfillment layer, which was about $420 million, which was for both, like for the entire order fulfillment layer, which includes shipping automation, reconciliation, etc.

items.quote: Courier aggregation as you right pointed at this point is nearly 85% of the revenue. The other remaining is contributed by the other two solutions. We believe that the aggregation will continue to be a primary revenue contributor going forward as well.

items.quote: Shipway currently serves a diverse client base of approximately 3000 businesses, which includes prominent brands such as Durex, Lenskart, Juicy Chemistry, Tresmode, Dot & Key, Amante, Libas, Sleepy Owl, and Sennheiser, to name a few.

items.statement: Initial assessment suggests low client overlap between Unicommerce (mid-market enterprise) and Shipway (SMB/mid-market)
items.quote: But prima facie, the overlap seems low because Shipway is largely being catering to SMBs and mid-market clients and our clients are largely in the mid-market enterprise segment.

items.statement: Acquisition funded through internal accruals
items.quote: So, on the funding of the transaction, we are funding this through our internal accruals.

items.statement: Shipway founders fully committed to combined vision; Shipway to operate independently initially with integration plan for cross-sell and cost synergies
items.quote: the founders of Shipway are fully Unicommerce e committed to this vision and want to achieve greater heights together, which we feel that as we take this end to end offering to the ecosystem , I think it will simplify a lot of things for ecommerce brands and

items.statement: Pricing per shipment expected to increase via cross-sell: add revenue lines (shipping automation, ConvertWay) on top of same shipment

items.statement: Integration risk: technology assessment of UniShip vs Shipway platforms ongoing; overlap exists in shipping automation; path forward to be decided after detailed assessment
items.quote: We are actually in a very initial stage with respect to the technology assessment of both the platforms. items.statement: Shipway historically loss-making (FY22-FY24); breakeven timeline uncertain; full-year consolidated guidance deferred to Q3 earnings call
items.quote: Given it is very early to comment upon the full year numbers and would be difficult for us also to give any guidance on full year numbers at standalone and console level at this point in time, we will give you some numbers in the quarter 3 Earning Call.

items.statement: Targets double-digit EBITDA margin soon from current 9.2%
items.quote: We are expecting that the double digit margin should come by the, very soon because we are at 9.2% average margin which is there currently.

items.quote: In next three years considering the revenue growth and operational efficiency with the product mix changes, I expect around 30% EBITDA growth. So, we will move from 9.12% to around 12% to 13% of our EBITDA.

items.statement: Current order book of Rs.165.51 crore billable in H2 FY25
items.quote: Rs. 165 crore is the quantum of the order book which I am right now having it, which will be all billable in H2.

items.statement: IPO proceeds used for property purchase; security operating center CAPEX in Q4 FY25
items.quote: Majority of our CAPEX investment will get into building our own stock for which we have taken a property in market, and that payment has been made from the IPO proceed, as per our RHP.

items.statement: PSB Alliance empanelment with 12 public sector banks seen as minimum Rs.100 crore opportunity over three years
items.quote: Over a period of three years, it will be a minimum 100 crore kind of an opportunity for partner like Orient.

items.statement: Data center solutions to contribute ~25% of revenue annually; managed services to grow from 15% to 25% in three years
items.quote: Data center solutions will contribute to approximately 25% of our overall revenue, is what I can promise every year.

items.quote: From the manage services we were trying to move from 15% to 25%. In next three years, we will be moving managed services from 15% to 25%.

items.quote: So margin profile ranges between gross margin I can talk about, so that depends on product to product and LOB-to-LOB, but typically it ranges from 12% to 17% as my gross margin.

items.statement: End user computing margins eroding; no conscious effort to grow that business
items.quote: End user computing is a very, competitive business and the margins are slightly eroding in those business and that's where we are not focusing for that piece of the business.

items.statement: Cyber security currently <10% of revenue; planning to increase year-on-year
items.quote: So, currently it is less than 10%. And we are planning to increase it year-on-year.

items.statement: Recurring revenue estimated at 35-37% of quarterly revenue from cloud and ITeS
items.quote: This quarter recurring revenue will be slightly difficult to tell right now, but it should be in the range of around 35% to 37% because any recurring revenue is between cloud and ITeS revenue is recurring revenue.

items.statement: Top 10 customers contribute 24.83% of revenue; customer retention 80-90% annually
items.quote: So current top 10 customers contributes to around 25% of our overall revenue, to be precise, 24.83%.

items.statement: Attrition rate 15-17%; revenue per employee ~Rs.50 lakh per year
items.quote: So current attrition rate in Orient is around 15% to 17%.

items.statement: PSB Alliance revenue expected to start from Q4 FY25
items.quote: I expect from 4th Quarter.

items.statement: Targets double-digit sales growth for FY25 and expects H2 FY25 to be significantly better than H1
items.quote: If we look into the overall year of FY'25, we would be surely targeting to close FY'25 with a double-digit sales growth.

items.quote: The drop has been approximately 11% only on the total volume. But the demand for carrying load has increased by 22%. So that's why we see that H2 will be far better than H1.

items.statement: H1 FY25 EBITDA margin improved 64 bps to 12.2%; Q2 margin up 58 bps to 13.1%
items.quote: The EBITDA margin for the half year improved by 64 basis points from 11.5% last year in H1FY24 to 12.2% in H1-FY'25.

items.quote: As far as our Q2 and H1 on the trailer axle and suspension segment, we have been able to increase our revenue by 7% if you compare it to the last year H1 figures.

items.quote: In fact, the cost saving of this would be at approximately 5% than the existing design.

items.statement: Export revenue grew 8x to INR8.9 cr in H1 (3.1% of revenue); bulk supplies of validated components to Leax Sweden start Q3 FY25

items.statement: Added ~80 new fabricator customers in last 12 months; field team of ~80 people; expanding across Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, West Bengal
items.quote: We are already present in states like Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, West Bengal, and in which we've onboarded, in fact, new customers, that is new fabricators in the last 12 months and that's been approximately 80 new customers in this field.

items.quote: We have increased our contribution from 44% to 45.2% on the trailer axle segment, mainly because the M&HCV segment has performed quite weak, especially in Q2. Okay. Hence, the revenue contribution has increased from the trailer axle business.

items.statement: Prime mover segment weak in July-August but recovering from September as OEMs shift production
items.quote: The July and August month on the prime mover segment has been weak. Okay. items.statement: Bharat Forge-American Axle deal seen as positive; no negative impact on Automotive Axles relationship
items.quote: It doesn't hamper our business. It will only help increase it. Because now there is another brand which will go into manufacturing.

items.statement: Monsoon and elections impacted Q2; M&HCV production dropped 11% YoY in Q2
items.quote: Though we faced some headwinds due to our lower anticipated demand in certain segments and a seasonally muted Q2 impact by monsoons & elections in the beginning, we maintained our revenue and improved profitability.

items.statement: Pre-sales for Q2 FY25 were INR 215 crores, up 12% year-on-year.

items.statement: Arkade Rare project accumulated 50+ bookings worth INR 80 crores on launch day.

items.quote: Arkade Vistas and Arkade Rare and Arkade Views, these three projects should be up for offering next year onwards, 25%.

items.quote: Out of INR 400 crores, about INR380 crores are in fixed deposit. As of 30th September.

items.quote: But broadly, it ranges between INR3,500 to INR4,500 per square feet, based on the details of the product.

items.quote: So, from acquisition to launch normally a year is more than enough. If the projects are smaller ones, say, standalone building, it can be in six months also.

items.statement: Industry expected to grow low single digit in FY25 on high base of 8.5% growth last year
items.quote: we have been maintaining that this year the industry would see a low single digit growth on a very high base of last year, which of course came up with the growth of 8 .5%

items.statement: Creta EV launch planned for Q4 FY25 (January)

items.statement: Pune plant start of vehicle production expected by Q3 FY26

items.statement: Plan to launch 4 EV models including Creta EV

items.statement: Cafe compliance met for FY24, on track for FY25 and FY26

items.statement: October festive month saw double-digit growth in enquiries and retails over last festive season
items.quote: In the just concluded festive month of October, we have recorded a double-digit growth in enquiries and retail s over last festive season

items.quote: In Q1, the domestic discount number was 1.5%, in Q2, the domestic discount number is 1.9%.
