items.quote: Maybe the PLI scheme with the government launch could change t he game for Indian manufacturers and maybe more and more products will be locally

items.statement: Maruti Suzuki announced new 1 million capacity plant in Gujarat; Toyota Kirloskar announced new facility in Maharashtra; JTEKT setting up Gujarat plant near Suzuki facility (7 km)
items.quote: Maruti Suzuki has announced a new facility in Gujarat with 1 million capacity and Toyota Kirloskar Motor has announced a new facility in Maharashtra.

items.statement: Maintenance capex benchmark at INR20-30 crores annually
items.quote: It will be around INR20 crores to INR30 crores. That's a normal bench ballpark number.

items.statement: Indian market showing headwinds after being insulated for a year
items.quote: While the Indian market had remained insulated over the last 1 year, we are now starting to see headwinds there as well.

items.statement: EMOSS revenue dropped sharply due to European recession and subsidy withdrawal
items.quote: EMOSS saw a total revenue of INR17 crores in the last quarter compared to INR46 crores in the previous quarter.

items.statement: EMOSS outlook muted for next 2 to 3 quarters before recovery expected
items.quote: And the outlook is still muted for the next 2 to 3 quarters, post which we can expect some recovery.

items.statement: Retrofit demand pickup slower than expected but has started in India
items.quote: The demand pickup in this business is slower than expected, but has started.

items.statement: New plant construction underway, expected ready in 2 months plus 10-12 months for machine setup
items.quote: The plant should be ready in the next 2 months, let's say. But then it will include additional 10 to 12 months of setting up the machines and so on.

items.statement: New plant contracted for 70,000-80,000 machine camshafts per month with significantly higher installable capacity
items.quote: What we have contracted for right now are 2 to 3 businesses, which would make up about 70,000, 80,000 machine camshafts per month, and this will contin ue to increase, but the total size of the plant is much bigger than the 70,000, 80,000 that I'm talking about

items.statement: New plant will produce assembled and machined camshafts, not cast camshafts
items.quote: This will be assembled camshafts, which are then machine also. So these are not cast camshafts.

items.statement: Non-engine braking system parts already productionized for European OEMs, volumes below plan due to slowdown
items.quote: but the big issue there has been, of course, the fact that these parts are getting supplied towards European OEMs. This is all export business. And because of the slowdown there, we have a drop in volumes as compared to what was planned in the original ramp-up

items.statement: Won retrofit orders from 4-5 Indian customers across logistics, biomedical waste, waste collection, e-commerce with large fleets
items.quote: Yes, of course, we have won orders from 4 to 5 different customers across India. These are in different spaces. One is a logistics company, one is a biomedical waste company, one is a large services company that is doing waste collection. Another is a pure logistics company and e-commerce.

items.statement: Approximately 5,000 vehicles across 5 retrofit customers represent potential fleet conversion
items.quote: There are about 5,000-odd vehicles just between these 5 customers.

items.statement: No state currently offers retrofit subsidies; EV purchase subsidies also withdrawn
items.quote: No. At this point of time, there are no states which offer any retrofitment subsidies. In fact, the subsidies that were there for new vehicle purchase also on the EV side are gone, right?

items.statement: Solar capacity expansion planned from 15MW to ~30MW over next 1-2 years at ~INR60 crores
items.quote: We are, like I said, also looking actively for inorganic opportunities and -- but that will -- that needs to be at the right time, the right company and so on. So there would be some amount earmarked for that. But I take back your suggestion on buybacks and so on, and we will discuss this internally with the Board.

items.statement: Solar expansion capex similar to previous INR60 crores for 15MW including land, panels, permissions
items.quote: So the total investment was about INR 60 crores for 15 megawatts, including land and panel and permissions and so on. So it would be similar to that.

items.statement: Casting capacity 12 million/year (1 million/month), machining capacity 4 million/year; utilization 75-80% foundry, 70-75% machining
items.quote: The casting capacity is about 12 million camshafts per year or 1 million per month. And the machining capacity is about 4 million camshafts per year. We are at about 80% utilization right now because of the reduction in volumes around the world, not just India, but around the world, we are down to about 75% to 80% on the foundry side and similarly, 70% to 75% on the machining side.

items.statement: Retrofit business not capital intensive; plans for micro factories across India to save logistics costs
items.quote: Sir, it's not a very capital -intensive business because there is no demand and if there's no machinery and tools and so on required. It's mainly a process of this disassembly and assembly. And in fact, as we scale up, we would intend to have small micro factories across the country rather than having one standardized setup in one place.

items.statement: Retrofit scale-up requires working capital to fund business operations
items.quote: And the only requirement for scale here would be working capital basically to fund the business.

items.statement: Actively looking for inorganic acquisition opportunities in India at right time and valuation
items.quote: We are, like I said, also looking actively for inorganic opportunities and -- but that will -- that needs to be at the right time, the right company and so on.

items.statement: Board to discuss buyback/dividend suggestion internally
items.quote: But I take back your suggestion on buybacks and so on, and we will discuss this internally with the Board.

items.statement: MFT Germany not profitable but self-sustaining; no fund transfer from PCL India
items.quote: I must add that, yes, it has been not profitable over the last couple of years, but it is not draining on PCL, right? We are not funding MFT's losses through PCL. It is still managing in liquidity and cash flow as a stand-alone company by itself, and there is no transfer of funds from India to MFT to sustain that company.

items.statement: EMOSS Europe scaling down headcount to sustain through recessionary environment
items.quote: We are sustaining the business. We are scaling it down, of course, in terms of the people and so on to sustain these times.

items.statement: OEM ambition for retrofit business still couple of years away; focus on proving technology first
items.quote: We are working on it. But like I've said before, it is still a couple of years away. We don't want to jump into something which is extremely capital -intensive, requires tremendous networks being created across the country and so on.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 20.5%, PAT margin 10.1% in Q2 FY25
items.quote: On a sta nd-alone basis, PCL, which houses the Camshafts business had a total income increased by 6.33% quarter-on-quarter to INR181 crores. EBITDA margin was 20.5%, and PAT margin was 10.1

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA increased 30.98% to INR35.6 crores, PAT INR8.4 crores (3.5% margin)
items.quote: Coming to the consolidated business, total income for Q2 decreased by 9.2% to INR238.8 crores. EBITDA increased by 30.98% to INR 35.6 crores. PBT was INR 19.6 crores, and PAT was INR8.4 crores, which is 3.5%.

items.statement: Camshaft business 50% domestic, 50% export; of export ~20% Europe, rest North America, Korea, Brazil, Mexico
items.quote: So at this point of time, about 50% of the business is domestic market and 50% is export. Out of that 50%, I would say about 20-odd percent is Europe and the rest is North America, Korea, Brazil, Mexico, etcetera.

items.statement: Management refuses to give forward-looking growth numbers for camshaft business over 2-3 years
items.quote: I would like to not give forward-looking numbers.

items.statement: European e-mobility sector seeing company failures due to subsidy shifts to war efforts and recession
items.quote: There are several -- at least 5 to 7 companies in the field of work that EMOSS is in or in the general electrification space that have gone belly up in the last 6 to 12 months simply because they cannot sustain in these markets.

items.statement: FY25 revenue guidance of INR3,300 crores including INR2,700 crores from core operations and INR600 crores from subsidiaries
items.quote: Our FY25 revenue guidance stands at INR3,300 crores which includes INR2,700 crores from our core operations and an additional INR600 crores from our subsidiaries which we acquired recently.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of INR6,300 crores with INR5,000 crores from parent and INR1,300 crores from subsidiaries
items.quote: Already we have given a blended of INR3,300 crores this year and FY27 is INR6,300 crores. So, INR1,300 crores from subsidiaries and INR5,000 from the parent companies.

items.statement: Next quarter blended revenue expectation of INR1,000 crores with parent at INR700-750 crores and subsidiaries at INR150-350 crores
items.quote: So, we are expecting a totally blended INR1,000 crores revenue in the next quarter, from the parent company INR700-INR750 crores what we are going by the run rate and from the subsidiary INR150 crores-INR350 crores.

items.statement: Volume guidance of 375-400 kgs per month by end of FY25, 550-600 kgs per month by FY26, and 750 kgs per month by FY27
items.quote: So, we are at 350 kgs per month run rate in H1 and we are having [inaudible] 375 kgs, 400 kgs per month till end of the year. And by FY27, we are expecting to go to 750 kgs per month.

items.statement: Gross margin target of 7-8% through optimized product mix and exports, long-term EBITDA margin of 5-5.5%
items.quote: We aim to achieve 7% to 8% gross margin through an optimized product mix and export, while maintaining a long-term EBITDA margin of 5% to 5.5%.

items.statement: PAT margin target of 3.5% for FY25 and 4% for FY26-27 driven by interest cost reduction from gold metal loans
items.quote: So, we are targeting to 3.5% by reducing our interest cost. We got little bit later for GML because of the bank policies and all, but I think we will be at 50%-60% of GML by December quarter and 80% by March quarter.

items.statement: Raised INR270 crores to broaden product portfolio in 18 carat gold and diamond jewellery and infuse capital into subsidiaries
items.quote: Additionally, I am excited to announce a significant milestone in our company's journey as we have successfully raised INR270 crores. This investment will be strategically allocated across broadening our product portfolio with expanded offerings in 18 carat gold and diamond jewellery to align with evolving customer preferences.

items.statement: Monthly production volume averaged 345 kgs in Q2 FY25, up 38% YoY from 250 kgs; standalone capacity utilization at 46%, subsidiaries at 30-33%
items.quote: This quarter, our monthly production volume averaged 345 kgs, significantly from 250 kgs per month last year, making a robust 38% year-on-year growth.

items.statement: Strong demand from festival and wedding season; 25% more weddings this year with 4.8 million weddings generating 6 billion revenue, jewellery contributing 25%
items.quote: 100% as all our client has given the outlook is very good for the wedding season as rates are also down by 5% of gold. Rates from 81,000, has come down to 76,000. So, it is helping to boost the season already. I told in my interview also that India is having 4.8 million weddings in this year. And 25% more weddings are happening in this quarter which will generate 6 billion revenue.

items.statement: Subsidiary EBITDA margin at 4.5%, targeting 5.5% with new verticals and design launches
items.quote: EBITDA for the subsidiary was 4.5%. So, in next quarter, December quarter total flow will happen. This quarter it was about I think 50 days or something has added to our company because we acquired in September 5th or 6th only.

items.statement: Export gross margins blended at 6-6.5% or 7%
items.quote: So, exports' gross margins are blended at 6%-6.5% or 7% also. So, blended it comes to 6.5% approximately.

items.statement: Gold prices down 5% from 81,000 to 76,000, boosting wedding season demand; industry expects gold prices to stabilize for 2-3 quarters after 20-25% spike
items.quote: 100% as all our client has given the outlook is very good for the wedding season as rates are also down by 5% of gold. Rates from 81,000, has come down to 76,000. So, it is helping to boost the season already.

items.statement: Increasing studded and 18 carat jewellery share; planning Moissanite jewellery in FY25 and exploring lab-grown diamonds post March quarter
items.quote: Yes studded and 18 Carat we are increasing, and we have infused the amount for 18 Carat and Studded only. So, in this December quarter also you will see that our Studded and 18 Carat is increasing.

items.statement: Onboarded CaratLane (1-1.5% of revenue, 50-58 kgs monthly volume potential) and PN Gadgil (INR50-100 crores sales potential); targeting Tanishq and mid-size corporates in Middle East/Singapore
items.quote: CaratLane contributed some, some part came in this quarter, December quarter and some part came in that quarter. So, we initially started with them with some products. So, now we are supplying 1% or 1.5% of the revenue, but in these two, three quarters, we will grow with them.

items.statement: Gold metal loan share increased from 10% to 20-22% last quarter, currently at 25%, targeting 50-60% by December quarter and 80% by March quarter
items.quote: So,. we were last quarter at 10%. We have moved approximately to 20%-22%. So, this quarter, we are hardly trying because some banks have other policies. So, I think by December quarter, we will be at 50%-60%.

items.statement: Total employee count at 800 (650 at parent, 150-180 at subsidiaries), up from 500-550 at end of FY24
items.quote: So, by the end of 24, we were at 500 employees-550 employees now we are at 650 employees at Sky Gold parent company and subsidiary, we are at 150 employees to 180 employees in both the subsidiaries. So, together we are at 800 employees.

items.statement: Declared 1:9 bonus issue (9 shares for 1 share); record date to be announced by secretarial team; no dividend planned for 1-2 years until cash flow positive and debt free
items.quote: 100% bonus is there. As and when required our CS team, Secretarial team and all the team will announce what is the procedure. They will know properly, and they will announce as and when required that the record date and the shares will be coming to your demat account.

items.statement: Inventory fully hedged on MCX daily; gold metal loan hedging policy ensures no gain/loss from gold price fluctuations
items.quote: Yes. So, already our inventory is totally hedged in the MCX, which is available in India to hedge. So, our inventory is already hedged, and we hedge every sale and purchase on a daily basis in the hedging platform MCX.

items.statement: Launching B2B ordering app by December quarter for real-time product visualization and daily ordering by retail clients like Kalyan Jewellers
items.quote: So, app we have already started with the app, but it is on a trial basis. I think by December quarter, it will be live totally. So, it will help the purchase manager of the stores, the sales heads Sky Gold Limited November19, 2024 and all can visualize each and every verticals and products. And they can order online

items.statement: Export policies improved significantly over last 5-10 years; daily export metal availability; no credit risk as exports are cash-and-carry with 7-10 day credit only to AAA/AA rated customers
items.quote: Exports policies are very good in this government. There was very difficulty in the exports and all. Documentations are very high. The last 5 years to 10 years, exports is very easy to do. We can get export metal daily and daily way out. For 365 days we can get export metal.

items.statement: Actively pursuing acquisition opportunities to strengthen market position and accelerate growth
items.quote: Additionally, we are actively pursuing acquisition opportunities to further strengthen our market position and accelerate growth.

items.statement: Revenue CAGR target of 40-50% over next 3-5 years with EBITDA margins sustained at 23-25%
items.quote: we look to grow the Company until next three to five years with the CAG R revenue of about 40% to 50% and this growth will also sustain the EBITDA margins in the range of 23% to 25

items.statement: Order book stands at Rs 206 crore as of 30 September 2024
items.quote: In the H1FY'25, we have and today as on 30th September, the order book is at ₹206 crores

items.statement: Advanced Rail Control had an order book of Rs 140 crore at acquisition, to be executed in 16-18 months
items.quote: the company had an order book of ₹140 crores in pending. So we hope that we will be completing in next 16 to 18 months approximately

items.statement: New 1-acre in-house facility in Bangalore acquired with Advanced Rail Control
items.quote: It's a 1-acre facility in Bangalore with a lot of capabilities, in-house. So all of that is for targeting this addressable market.

items.statement: Transitioning from product manufacturing to solution provider across traction, coaching, locomotive, wayside, and embedded electronics
items.quote: We always focus on three to five years ahead from today and always keep churning out products accordingly and keep the development process at the core of the Company as a core strength.

items.statement: Addressable market opportunity across product lines estimated at Rs 550 crore by 2030
items.quote: Expected business opportunity from all the product lines which we just shared can contribute up to ₹550 crores of a target opportunity size until 2030

items.statement: Kavach approval process involves RDSO product feasibility, field trials, and SIL 4 certification; milestones being crossed
items.quote: First, the product has to be developed, then the capacity assessment has to happen. Then the product feasibility has to be checked and approved by RDSO, then it goes for a field trial. And parallelly , the SIL 4 certification

items.statement: Preferential funds used to reduce Advanced Rail Control leverage, fund working capital, capex, and acquisitions
items.quote: It's also to reduce leverage of Advanced Rail in terms of loans. It is also to further invest on Capex and further acquisitions and so it's a mix of all.

items.statement: Preferential issue proceeds allocated to working capital, debt reduction, capex, and acquisitions
items.quote: Actually, Rahul ji, it's a mix of all. It's also to fund the working capital requirement. It's also to reduce leverage of Advanced Rail in terms of loans. It is also to further invest on Capex and further acquisitions.

items.statement: Preferential funds partly used for working capital requirements
items.quote: It's also to fund the working capital requirement.

items.statement: Demand in Europe, the second largest market, has been weak due to macroeconomic and geopolitical factors; global production capacity exceeds demand, pressuring prices and margins.
items.quote: Demand in Europe, the company's second largest market, has been weak due to macroeconomic and geopolitical factors. Additionally, production capacities globally currently exceed demand, putting a pressure on price and margins.

items.statement: Company submitted an application to DGTR seeking anti-dumping duty recommendation on insoluble sulphur imports from China and Japan.
items.quote: To address the issue of low-cost imports, the company has also submitted an application to the DGTR seeking a recommendation of anti -dumping duty on insoluble sulphur imports from China and Japan.

items.statement: Anticipates significant growth in Indian market for insoluble sulphur due to expanding tyre industry and increasing demand for premium long-lasting tyres.
items.quote: Going ahead, we anticipate significant growth in the Indian market for insoluble sulphur compounds due to the expanding tyre industry. Demand for premium long - lasting tyres is increasing.

items.statement: Indian tyre manufacturers expected to invest INR7,000+ crores in FY25-26 driven by replacement and OEM demand.
items.quote: It is anticipated that Indian tyre manufacturers will allocate an investment of INR7,000 plus crores in FY '25-'26, driven by the increasing demand from both the replacement and original equipment markets.

items.statement: Higher international freight rates impacted current quarter by INR6 crores; freight rates now showing correction which should help margins.
items.quote: The impact of higher freight rate in the current quarter was about INR6 crores.

items.statement: Chinese insoluble sulphur prices near cost break-even; limited scope for further price decline, so contribution margin unlikely to fall further.
items.quote: Globally, I believe that the price of insoluble sulphur, as far as China is concerned, is at a level where there is a very little scope of further correction. So, looking into these factors, I would believe that the chances of the contribution going down are slim.

items.statement: Capacity utilization below optimum; additional 5,000 tons capacity remains unutilized; sales tonnage up 10-12% YoY on quarterly and six-monthly basis.
items.quote: As far as new capacities are concerned our capacity utilization is below optimum level, and therefore, there is still room for growth within the existing capacity. Or, in other terms, the additional capacities still remain unutilized.

items.statement: Global capacity utilization estimated around 70%; no capacity additions in last 1.5 years; Flexsys permanently shut down one US line.
items.quote: in our estimates, the global capacity utilisation would be around 70%.

items.statement: Key raw materials are Sulphur (100% sourced domestically) and coating oil (85-90% domestic); both follow international pricing trends and vary fortnightly/monthly.
items.quote: So, our key raw material are Sulphur and coating oil. These are the two key raw materials that we have.

items.statement: Coating oil prices stable with downward trend in last 3-4 months; Sulphur prices seen uptick in last 3-4 months after earlier decline.
items.quote: In the last 3, 4 months, coating oil has been stable with a downward trend. As far as Sulphur is concerned, we have seen an uptick in the Sulphur prices in the last 3, 4 months.

items.statement: Only exporter of insoluble sulphur from India; imports account for 40-45% of domestic consumption.
items.quote: So, from India, there is only one person who exports and that is OCCL Limited. So, we are the only exporters from India. As far as the percentage of consumption from imports in India of insoluble sulphur is concerned, it is in the range of 40% to 45%.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty process typically takes about 1 year; expected decision by March or Q1 FY26.
items.quote: normally what we have heard from our advisors is they take about 1 year to process and impose anti -dumping duty. If that is the case, probably it would happen by March or first quarter of '25-'26.

items.statement: Three major factors depressing margins: higher international freight rates, geopolitical situation in Europe, and higher capacities in China; margins may return to historical 25% once resolved but will take time.
items.quote: See, currently, the markets, the margins are depressed because of three reasons. And because of higher international freight rates, geopolitical situation in Europe, which is a significant market for us, higher capacities in China. Once these are resolved to a certain extent, then we can look at margins returning to the earlier level, but it will take some time.

items.statement: Pricing pressure emanating from China affects all competitors including Flexsys and Shikoku; slowdown uniformly affecting industry, not losing market share.
items.quote: No, it is uniformly affecting the industry.

items.statement: No significant seasonality in domestic tyre production and insoluble sulphur consumption between H1 and H2.
items.quote: In the domestic market, there is not a very significant seasonality as far as tyre production and consumption of insoluble sulphur goes. If you compare H1 versus H2, we have not seen a very significant impact in terms of seasonality there.

items.statement: Surplus cash will first be used to reduce debt and working capital drawdown; then invested in standard treasury instruments like debt funds.
items.quote: the first thing will be to reduce debt and reduce the drawdown of the working capital limit. And after that, when we have it, we will put it judiciously in things like debt funds and all of those things.

items.statement: Dividend policy unchanged: payout of 50% of PAT or free cash flow generated, whichever is lower.
items.quote: The stated uploaded dividend policy says 50% of PAT or the free cash flow generated. So, that is a very clear policy that is there, that all the free cash flow generated w ill be paid out up to 50% of PAT.

items.statement: Inventory de-stocking by foreign companies that occurred last year has completed; no such factor currently playing out.
items.quote: Now, that has happened. Now, there is no such factor as of now.

items.statement: US revenue share not disclosed; potential Trump tariffs premature to assess; uniform tariffs unlikely to significantly impact company.
items.quote: Well, we cannot share the revenue share from US as of now. As far as tariffs are concerned, it's very premature to say because we do not know what is going to happen.

items.statement: All assets and liabilities including fixed assets carried at same values as pre-demerger Oriental Carbon & Chemicals Limited balance sheet; no change in carrying values.
items.quote: All the assets and all the liabilities, including the fixed assets, are stated at the same carrying value as they were in the Oriental Carbon & Chemicals Limited balancesheet. So, there has not been change in the carrying value of either any of the assets or the liabilities.

items.statement: Invested INR1.25 crores in captive solar plant to supply power to Dharuhera plant; investment arm demolished.
items.quote: So, that INR1.25 crores is because we have invested in a captive solar plant and that is why that is there because that will supply us solar power to the Dharuhera plant.

items.statement: Focus on customized grades addressing higher technical standards and range of insoluble sulphur products; reducing carbon footprint and sustainability leadership.
items.quote: The second is product quality and innovation, where we continue to manufacture customized grades or grades that address higher technical standards, as well as providing a range of different insoluble sulphur products.

items.statement: Targeting higher value customers through key approvals and long-term contracts with marquee customers.
items.quote: The third is tapping into the higher value customers by obtaining key customer approvals and getting into long-term contracts with the marquee customers.

items.statement: No formal guidance given; expects freight cost tailwinds in H2 FY25; anti-dumping duty unlikely to impact H2; hopes for volume gains in new year.
items.quote: We normally do not give guidance, but as I have said, that we are seeing tailwinds as far as international freights are concerned. So, that should help us. Secondly, okay, you are talking about H2, then anti -dumping is something which might not happen by then. But in terms of freight, we are hopeful that will come down and we might gain some quantities for the new year that might add to the top l

items.statement: No BIS quality control order procedures started for insoluble sulphur yet.
items.quote: Right now, we have not started the BIS procedures.

items.statement: Post-demerger market cap halved from ~INR800 crores to ~INR400 crores despite clean listed entity and share split; management also confused by valuation drop.
items.quote: it's correct that the combined market cap earlier was roughly INR800. And today, the market cap of the sulphur company is something in the range of 400. Now, as management, if somebody asks me, I am also confused that why it's gone from 800 to 400.

items.statement: H2 FY25 expected to deliver stronger results with improved profitability and cash flow as crushing season progresses
items.quote: Therefore, we remain confident that consistent with past trends, the second half of the fiscal year will deliver stronger results, and we are optimistic about achieving improved profitability and cash flow in the upcoming months.

items.statement: Biobased specialty chemicals capacity increases visible from Q4 2025
items.quote: The improved debt equity position and savings in principal and interest payments will be strategically used to advance our biobased chemical business, as I mentioned earlier and , some increase in the biobased chemicals will start becoming visible from Q4 2025.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of Rs. 240 crores allocated for debt repayment to free cash flow for biobased chemical capacity expansion
items.quote: We intend to allocate Rs. 240 crores from the net proceeds for the full or partial repayment or prepayment of certain company borrowings.

items.statement: Grain-based ethanol facility CAPEX under evaluation; stronger update expected next quarter
items.quote: So right now, we are working on the capital expenditure required for the grain-based ethanol and we would be able to give an much stronger update in the next quarter call.

items.statement: Ethanol production capacity of 570 KL/day as of June 30, 2024; environmental clearances secured to expand to 1 million liters/day
items.quote: As of June 30, 2024, it has an installed rectified spirit capacity of 600 kilo liters per day, and we have secured the necessary environmental clearances. To expand this capacity to 1 million liters per day, creating an optionality for us to scale operations.

items.statement: Planning 2G ethanol demonstration plant using bagasse at Sameerwadi with Rs. 150 million grant
items.quote: We are planning a demonstration plant of our 2G ethanol production using bagasse at Sameerwadi, a significant milestone backed by a grant of Rs. 150 million from the Centre for Higher Technology under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.

items.statement: Biobased specialty chemicals business stronger in FY25 with higher demand expected in H2 2025
items.quote: In terms of the biobased specialty chemicals chemical business is stronger in this financial year and in some of the chemicals that we operate in, we are expecting to see a higher demand in H2 of 2025 itself.

items.statement: Strong demand in fragrances for 1,3-butylene glycol and newly launched ethyl vinyl ether
items.quote: We are definitely seeing strong demand in sectors such as fragrances, where we are making products such as 1,3-butylene glycol that we make and we also launched our product, ethyl vinyl ether a couple of months ago.

items.statement: Biobased specialty chemicals have very strong gross margins
items.quote: I just would like to say that the margins across the biobased specialty chemicals are quite strong. In the exact number, I would like to not be able to give immediately, but the margin numbers for the biobased specialty chemicals are a very strong gross margin.

items.statement: Industry requested ethanol price increase for sugarcane juice and B-Heavy; awaiting government response
items.quote: So, the industry has requested for an increase in ethanol price, either from sugarcane juice and from B-Heavy. Currently, we are waiting for a favorable response from the government, and we hope they consider the industry's request.

items.statement: Sugarcane price at Rs. 3,000 per ton ex-field in operating area
items.quote: I think the factory is paying a price of Rs. 3000 per ton ex-field for sugarcane in where we operate.

items.statement: Government restored ethanol blending program from sugarcane juice after good 2024 monsoon
items.quote: And the second thing is, looking at the availability of sugarcane in the coming year, the government has restored the ethanol blending program from sugarcane juice, which will also enable us to crush additional cane to convert that into ethanol.

items.statement: Bid for over 10 crore liters ethanol; allotted 7.5 crore liters (5.4 crore juice, 2.5 crore B-Heavy)
items.quote: So, the total allotted quantity from the OMC is 7.5 crores litres plus. So, on 5.4 crores for the juice and for 2.5 crores for B-Heavy.

items.statement: Distinguished client base includes Hershey's India, Hindustan Coca-Cola, LANXESS, IFF; exports to 20+ countries
items.quote: We are privileged to serve a distinguished client base that includes Hershey's India, Hindustan Coca-Cola, LANXESS, IFF among others. Our international footprint has grown significantly with exports to over 20 countries.

items.statement: Jivana retail brand grew almost 3x in last 3 financial years
items.quote: The Jivana brand has grown almost three times in the last three financial years.

items.statement: Bulk of ethanol produced goes to blending program; biobased chemicals ethanol mostly procured locally or imported

items.statement: Expense ratio target for next financial year is 35% plus allowances, roughly 36%

items.quote: Inherently, you know, our own assessment is that the growth trajectory on retail will continue to be a CAGR of 17%-18% over the next four five years.

items.statement: Retail loss ratio for full year expected to settle around 65%
items.quote: Current year H1, the loss ratio, given the seasonality of infection, it's around 64.5% H1 and the loss ratio for whole year for retail, we expect that to settle around the same number, 65%-odd.

items.quote: So, the 40% new business growth number that I referred to on retail for H1 this financial year comes from a combination of value growth, which is roughly about 7%, 8 %, and the balance actually is Lives's growth.
